findings: Writer contains exactly writer/sandbox/__init__.py and writer/sandbox/executor.py; both are absent from the frozen PF head.
The executor is resource-limited but not isolated: temporary cwd, timeout and ulimit controls do not prevent ordinary user-level filesystem/network/process effects.
allow_network=false is a dead configuration flag in this implementation.
The child inherits the complete parent environment.
The rust path compiles with rustc but does not launch the resulting binary, so compile and execute phases are conflated.
dedup: Generic weak-sandbox lesson overlaps prior Genesis archaeology; only Writer-specific enforcement/phase oracles are new.
